name: Mishael
bio: Mishael is the son of Uzziel, Aaron's cousin. After Nadab and Abihu were consumed by fire from the LORD for offering strange fire, Moses called Mishael and his brother Elzaphan to carry the bodies, still in their priestly tunics, out of the camp from before the sanctuary — taking on the heavy, grieving task of handling the aftermath of the tragedy (Leviticus 10:4-5).
